notes: Ticker ambiguity check: this package assumes NYSE ticker SW corresponds to Smurfit Westrock plc.

EBIT definition: used Operating profit as the EBIT proxy from the consolidated statements of operations. ([s203.q4cdn.com](https://s203.q4cdn.com/463220948/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/SW-10K-December-31-2025.pdf))
D&A definition: used Depreciation, depletion and amortization from cash flow statement. ([s203.q4cdn.com](https://s203.q4cdn.com/463220948/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/SW-10K-December-31-2025.pdf))
Capex definition: used Capital expenditures from cash flow statement. ([s203.q4cdn.com](https://s203.q4cdn.com/463220948/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/SW-10K-December-31-2025.pdf))

NWC construction: NWC level computed as (Total current assets - Cash and cash equivalents) - (Total current liabilities - Current portion of debt). Historical NWC for 2023 uses the 2024 Annual Report balance sheet. ([s203.q4cdn.com](https://s203.q4cdn.com/463220948/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/SW-10K-December-31-2025.pdf))

Merger comparability caution: 2024–2025 results reflect the Smurfit Kappa/WestRock combination; 2023 includes a different operating/combination basis, so only used as a historical reference and smoothed into base-case ratios. ([smurfitwestrock.com](https://www.smurfitwestrock.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/smurfit-westrock-reports-fourth-quarter-and--full-year-2025-results))

Tax rate: used FY 2025 effective tax rate (income tax expense / income before income taxes) as the DCF tax_rate. ([s203.q4cdn.com](https://s203.q4cdn.com/463220948/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/SW-10K-December-31-2025.pdf))
WACC is an analyst assumption (not explicitly provided in the filings/press releases retrieved in this run).
Terminal framework: terminal_method = gordon_growth; therefore terminal_exit_ebitda_multiple is null.

NOL utilization percent not disclosed in the retrieved materials; set to null and left for the model operator to parameterize. NOL carryforwards (balance) are from FY 2025. ([s203.q4cdn.com](https://s203.q4cdn.com/463220948/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/SW-10K-December-31-2025.pdf))
Comps forward NTM multiples (EV/NTM Revenue, EV/NTM EBITDA, P/E NTM) were not sourced from accessible primary/quality inputs in this run; comp multiple fields are left null.

catalysts: Delivery of the 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance ($5.0B–$5.3B) as synergies and operating improvements translate into results. ([smurfitwestrock.com](https://www.smurfitwestrock.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/smurfit-westrock-reports-fourth-quarter-and--full-year-2025-results))

Progress toward medium-term targets (e.g., ~$7B adjusted EBITDA by 2030) and associated capital return policy execution. ([smurfitwestrock.com](https://www.smurfitwestrock.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/smurfit-westrock-medium-term-investor-update))
Improving working capital discipline and operational stability across regions, particularly in North America and Europe recovery cycles.
company_overview: Smurfit Westrock is a global paper-based packaging company with operations across North America, EMEA & APAC, and Latin America.

The company reports in USD and provides net sales, operating profit, and D&A in its consolidated financial statements. ([s203.q4cdn.com](https://s203.q4cdn.com/463220948/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/SW-10K-December-31-2025.pdf))
current_context: FY 2025 produced net sales of $31.179B with operating profit of $1.719B (EBIT proxied by operating profit). ([s203.q4cdn.com](https://s203.q4cdn.com/463220948/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/SW-10K-December-31-2025.pdf))

In its FY 2025 results release (Feb 2026), management guided 2026 adjusted EBITDA to $5.0B–$5.3B and discussed an accelerated growth path via its medium-term plan. ([smurfitwestrock.com](https://www.smurfitwestrock.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/smurfit-westrock-reports-fourth-quarter-and--full-year-2025-results))

A Medium-Term Investor Update (Feb 11, 2026) targets ~$7B adjusted EBITDA by 2030 and assumes market growth of 1.6% (North America), 1.7% (Europe), and 2.0% (Latin America) with through-the-cycle pricing around current levels. ([smurfitwestrock.com](https://www.smurfitwestrock.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/smurfit-westrock-medium-term-investor-update))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth is anchored to the company’s stated market growth assumptions (low-to-mid single digits) rather than aggressive pricing or volume outperformance. ([smurfitwestrock.com](https://www.smurfitwestrock.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/smurfit-westrock-medium-term-investor-update))

Base-case EBIT margin modestly expands from 2025 levels, consistent with a gradual improvement in operating leverage while recognizing integration and downtime risks. ([smurfitwestrock.com](https://www.smurfitwestrock.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/smurfit-westrock-medium-term-investor-update))

Capital intensity and D&A intensity are modeled using recent historical ratios (2024–2025) to reflect ongoing reinvestment and asset base evolution. ([s203.q4cdn.com](https://s203.q4cdn.com/463220948/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/SW-10K-December-31-2025.pdf))

Working capital intensity (NWC as % of sales) is kept relatively stable vs. 2025 with a gradual normalization, to avoid overstating FCF generation. ([s203.q4cdn.com](https://s203.q4cdn.com/463220948/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/SW-10K-December-31-2025.pdf))
key_risks: Sustained weakness in corrugated/paper market pricing and/or volume declines that compress revenue growth and margin.

Integration execution risk (downtime, costs, and synergy realization) given the company’s post-combination operating ramp. ([smurfitwestrock.com](https://www.smurfitwestrock.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/smurfit-westrock-reports-fourth-quarter-and--full-year-2025-results))
Leverage and interest-rate exposure impacting effective cost of capital and downstream valuation sensitivity.
